topic.title: Kafka Topic
topic.description: Topic to consume; supports {asset}/{stream} placeholders. Omit for a writeback-only stream (control_topic only).

payload_field.title: Payload Field
payload_field.description: Optional: dotted path to a value inside a JSON record value (e.g. readings.pressure). Omit to use the whole value.

key.title: Record Key Filter
key.description: Optional: only consume records whose key matches; supports {asset}/{stream} placeholders.

control_topic.title: Control Topic
control_topic.description: Optional: control changes for this stream are produced to this topic; supports {asset}/{stream} placeholders.
